2026-09-21 scope rulings before implementation (single-developer mode).

OWNER RULING (asked in-session 2026-09-21, owner selected "Support-share only"): acceptance criterion 1 of the 2026-09-18 note is AMENDED. hsmm/v4 carries the tagged SupportAssessment (Assessed / Unestablished / NotApplicable) with a derived share and its explicit support basis, but it does NOT carry D1B's TypedSupport source intervals. v4 keeps refusing non-text source support with HsmmCodecError.UnsupportedSupport, as v3 does, consistent with ADR 0007:1064-1066 and api-stability.md:64-66. Exact source intervals travel only in the mapping-records schema (bd-01M2WVENSB0P955Y0B603CC20Y).

AC7, REBASE OR REDO: REDO on current main, reusing the b33fe5b5 candidate on scout/support-assessment-v4 as source material (SupportBasis/reason enums/SupportAssessment types, SupportAssessmentSuite compile-refusal courts, AlignCodecSuite attack tests, and the 6a21892 golden as a no-numeric-movement check). Evidence (read-only survey at main 64f5d86c): merge-base e584ad6d is 593 commits behind; the candidate's 4 commits touch 29 paths, 22 of which changed on main since; git merge-tree reports 5 conflicting files / 6 hunks (cost.scala vs overflow fix c44e5384, hsmm.scala layerUse, codec/align.scala D1B UnsupportedSupport guards x2, AlignCodecSuite, WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite); 6 GraphHsmm.infer callers added since the base would break on b33's required SupportBasis argument; b33 carries none of D1B's typed refusal/platform labels; neither required review approved b33. Most important: b33 also contains the separate "estimand B" numeric change (drop Propositional/Entity when prerequisite absent), which moves posterior/flow/logLikelihood/totals, whereas the earlier 6a21892/c53818f v4 goldens are bit-identical to main's v3 golden on every numeric field. Support honesty alone moves no numbers.

DEFAULTS TAKEN (agent judgement, stated so the owner can override):
- Estimand B stays OUT of G1; any numeric movement in this ticket is a defect to investigate, not a rebaseline.
- No SupportBasis threading through GraphHsmm.infer and no fallible LocalCostModel here; authenticated cost-model invocation stays with bd-01M1DA6NJXYT4NEA18745FM3KY / bd-01M2TACM78289S4TECE91GT5K2. G1 derives the share from ingredients carried inside the sealed breakdown (measured terms, nonempty eligible terms, exact eligible weights) and the wire recomputes and checks it.
- Goldens are platform-labelled (JVM/JS vs Native), following the docs/refactor/evidence/wog-hsmm-baseline-20260919 precedent; the Native 1-ULP policy stays on bd-01M1D215EY4T5BR0VRJ694AMBQ.
